form:FormGroup.label: Entity ID Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: The column identifying each entity - a person, vehicle or asset. Events are grouped by it, so each distinct value becomes one thing drawn on the map. It must name a column this query selects, by the alias the query gives it; the default query aliases this column 'Entity ID'. If it names nothing the query selects, no entity reaches the map at all, even though the query still returns rows - so the map looks as though playback is switched off.

form:FormGroup.label: Location ID Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: The column holding where each event happened. Either the key of the object the event happened at, in which case the entity is drawn wherever that object currently is, or literal coordinates in the form 'map, x, y', which are fixed and will not follow the object if it is moved.
